entry.title: dotnet/aspnetcore - Issues & Pull Requests - 2025-08-01
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Announcement 525 has typo in title #63048
  • Minimal API Validation throws exception for endpoint that accepts JsonPatchDocument #63047
    10.0-rc1
  • Perf regression: multiple_queries #63045
  • Perf regression: json, json, json #63044
  • Perf improvement: json_middleware #63043
  • Allow access modifiers for Razor component classes (e.g., internal for Blazor components) #63041
  • Why is this returning true ? string.Empty.All(_ => char.IsNumber(_)); #63039
  • Perf regression: antiforgery-generation, json_middleware #63031
  • Model nullable types using allOf in JSON schema #63029
    10.0-rc1
  • Request Browser-Testing Dependencies Update #63028

Closed

  • OpenAPI - Polymorphism class does not work for response #59214
  • Generated OpenAPI schema is invalid for nested recursive polymorphic type, even without arrays #61722
  • Invalid openapi.json produced when having properties of the declaring type #58340
  • Feature `Semantic classification` is currently unavailable due to an internal error #59736
    Backlog
  • OpenApi DefaultValueAttribute on properties isn't considered on FromQuery model properties in controllers #61934
    .NET 10 Planning
  • Issue with OpenAPI Documentation Generation When Using [FromQuery] in a Separate Class #61297
    Backlog
  • InvalidOperationException thrown if attempting to document a controller endpoint without an explicit HTTP method #60914
    10.0-rc1
  • JSON Patch request body should use content-type application/json-patch+json #61956
    Backlog
  • IL-related diagnostic warnings not reported as errors #61827
    .NET 11 Planning
  • Update to .NET 10 #57461
    10.0-preview7
  • 1ES template cleanup #54672
    Backlog
  • 'The process cannot access the file' during CI build sometimes #32219
  • Min API validation extracts bad display name from DisplayAttribute #61589
    10.0-rc1
  • Consider deprecating `Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Client` package #59208
    10.0-preview7
  • [Open API] Nullability set on component schema level and not operation. Causing multiple component schemas being generated. #58617
    10.0-rc1
  • Perf improvement: ApiCrudListProducts #62960
  • On .NET 10 PR 3 MVC fails to find views #61465
  • MapFallbackToFile is returning 404 #49738
  • OpenAPI schema generation for nullable enums produce a null value option #60986
  • Microsoft.Extensions.ApiDescription.Server - Nullable query parameters are not generated as nullable in OpenAPI Document #62345
  • Output formatter unexpectedly returns new instance of scoped service #61803
  • OpenAPI: Enums are missing description, and x-enumNames #62968
  • OpenAPI: Any type inside of Task<ActionResult<WorkInProgressResult>> (e.g., WorkInProgressResult is not included in the schema #62972
  • [OpenApi] SchemaTransformer Bug #62893
    Backlog
  • Default 404 response results in "Your connection to this site isn't secure" error #48096

PullRequests

Created

  • [main] Source code updates from dotnet/dotnet #63046
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • Added usage of TimeProvider instead of DateTimeOffset #63042
    area-identity, community-contribution
  • Change `contentType` parameter in `GetSupportedContentTypes` to nullable #63040
    area-mvc, community-contribution
  • [release/8.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `c67de11` to `373af2e` #63038
    area-infrastructure, 8.0.x
  • [main] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `32f9f4c` to `373af2e` #63037
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops
  • [release/9.0] (deps): Bump src/submodules/googletest from `c67de11` to `373af2e` #63035
    area-infrastructure, 9.0.x
  • Server memory pool metrics updates #63032
    area-networking
  • Auth metrics updates #63030
    area-auth

Merged

  • [Mvc] Avoid exception in route analyzer #63033
    area-mvc, community-contribution, 10.0-rc1
  • [OpenAPI] Get parameter description with [FromQuery] #62986
    area-mvc, community-contribution, feature-openapi, 10.0-rc1
  • [OpenApi] Ignore unknown HTTP methods #63034
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal, 10.0-rc1
  • Update media type for JSON Patch #62988
    area-mvc, feature-json-patch, community-contribution, feature-openapi, 10.0-rc1
  • [main] (deps): Bump dotnet/arcade from e2fed65f9c524d12c64876194ae4ce177b935bb3 to 40693ae2ee51e447f6ca96d07bc1ba779dcb9b9c #63036
    area-infrastructure, Type: Dependency Update :arrow_up_small:, build-ops

Updated

  • Add logging for OpenAPI schema default value type mismatches #63027
    Attention: Shared Code Modified
  • Update identity metrics with feedback #62982
    area-identity
  • Avoid pausing circuit when it's disposed #63010
    area-blazor, 10.0-rc1
  • [release/9.0] [OpenAPI] Use invariant culture for TextWriter #62239
    community-contribution, feature-openapi, area-minimal
  • [main] Use PipeReader JsonSerializer overloads #62914
    pending-ci-rerun
